openings.decision: A and E listed it (window, optional), B did not. Seen in the drawing: black wall - cyan glazing - black wall on one 0.285 m line, fixed (no door block, leaf or slide track; WT-01 vision modules), so kind window, not a door and not eitherKind; ends read off the module joints / wall-hatch ends, 4.500 m. Whether it is an opening at all is the one thing the drawing cannot settle: as drawn it is the definition's window set in a wall gap, but the opaque bays carry the same 1.5 m mullion grid and the same 0.285 m depth, so the whole line also reads as one curtain-wall facade of opaque and vision modules (the definition's continuous curtain-wall facade, i.e. a glass wall). Kept as an optional window, not scored either way; a window here is harmless in 3D (glass in the same place).

method: Read the comparison packet (11 accepted, 1 dispute). Rebuilt every accepted opening from prims.pkl (wall-hatch ends on the wall centre line, A-DOOR-FRAM jambs, door-block inserts) and 0.25 m-grid zoom renders: all 11 hold, ends match to the mm, nothing contradicts them (kinds follow the conventions: lift gap with no leaf = optional passage; one sliding door = one opening). Adjudicated the single dispute L30E-11 (curtain-wall glazing in the x=18.572 line): geometry, family names (WT-01-UPDATED-INSTANCE North Facade 4 vs opaque A-WALL bays), mullion grid and door blocks examined; decided kind window, ends -47.465 / -51.965, optional because glass-wall vs window-in-wall cannot be settled from the plan. Missed-opening check: listed every A-DOOR* entity in the box (all 8 belong to the known door blocks), fitted every arc in the box for door-swing-like sweeps (only the known doors), listed every wall hatch loop and tested each wall line for collinear gaps and wall ends facing a side, then rendered the part in two halves with a marker at every final opening and looked for unmarked swings, leaves, tracks, door blocks, window bands and clean gaps. Two gaps found and rejected (corridor mouth at x=13.17; 0.37 m slot at x=18.2); no new openings. Ids L30E-01..12 run north to south by centre y.
